qualification_scope: Attestation of the clean-source B6N8-K model-authority closure; no provider execution or physical-state generation.

evidence.seal_algorithm: All regular files recursively except EVIDENCE_CONTENT_SHA256.txt, including EVIDENCE_ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.json; POSIX relative paths sorted by casefold while preserving original spelling; each entry is UTF-8 relative path + NUL + raw bytes, with no inter-entry/trailing separator.

initializer_and_boundaries.T0_initializer_interface: R6_PRE_ORBDATA_TRANSIENT_THERMAL_COUPLING; conditional profile input T(z,T0), not an existing physical state
initializer_and_boundaries.surface_boundary: Held values may be evaluated only as explicit REDUCED_MODEL_BOUNDARY_SCENARIOS; no physical surface-history constancy is asserted.
initializer_and_boundaries.lower_boundary: Held initializer-compatible model-domain base may be a reduced-model scenario; MODEL_DOMAIN_BASE is not PHYSICAL_LAB and no physical lower-boundary history is asserted.
initializer_and_boundaries.A_C_temporal_role: UNRESOLVED_TEMPORAL_ROLE; reference source-term value/applicability does not establish a time history; zero is not implicit.
initializer_and_boundaries.A_M_temporal_role: UNRESOLVED_TEMPORAL_ROLE; reference source-term value/applicability does not establish a time history; zero is not implicit.
initializer_and_boundaries.HWR_role: Initializer/model-coordinate configuration and age-dependent positive-age flux rule; not a T0-to-T1 boundary trajectory or world flux history.
initializer_and_boundaries.HWR_temporal_adapter: REQUIRES_MODEL_ADAPTATION for ocean age/support evolution; preserve separate age-zero ridge rule.
initializer_and_boundaries.support_oceanic_result: Native-cell material/support identity, surface-boundary class, geometry and provider coverage must remain eligible. Unknown or ungoverned support/class change fails closed; Buck support remains separate.
initializer_and_boundaries.material_applicability: REFERENCE_VALUE_EXISTS != APPLICABILITY_BOUND; explicit native-support to reduced material-role association and provider validation remain required.

omitted_processes.status: source term present in initializer form; A_C/A_M temporal/material applicability unresolved

surface_step.assumptions: Single instantaneous step at a homogeneous constant-diffusivity half-space boundary over the full T0-to-T1 duration, using existing specialist crust diffusivity corners; diagnostic only.

conduction_and_sensitivity.sensitivity_acceptance_criterion: UNRESOLVED; small diagnostic response alone is not an acceptance criterion.

Adjudicate conduction-only sufficiency and omitted pre-event processes at the intended target support/depth.
Bind ocean age/support evolution or explicitly exclude unsupported ocean cells; preserve the separate age-zero ridge rule.
Set an explicit boundary-sensitivity acceptance criterion tied to the downstream thermal/Buck target.
